title: Founding Product Designer
description: Founding Product Designer (UX/UI & Research) London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £70 - £85K + early-team equity The role We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability. Join Bite as our first in-house designer working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment. Why join Bite The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product. You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. There's no design team to inherit and no feature factory to work around. You set the direction, the patterns and the quality bar, and you'll prototype, test and ship rapidly with a small team that can pivot, fast. Your work ships to people who pay. The beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions. What we're building Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive. Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of those changes to every affected file. What you’ll do Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality. Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns. Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint. Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap. Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter. Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities. Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights. Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements. Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions. Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless. Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite. What we need from you A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products). An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team. A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment. A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale. description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. We're bringing in a recent graduate on a 6-month contract to strengthen the controls around our daily loan funding and to add capacity across payments and partner indemnity recovery. A large part of our AutoLend lending is originated through third-party partners, and you'll own the daily process that verifies funds are flowing correctly through that chain before we release the next day's payments. You'll run that control every day, then use the remaining time to help us make it faster, better evidenced and, where possible, automated. This is a hands-on operational role and a strong first job in fintech. You don't need finance experience; we'll teach you the payments side. You do need to be numerate, methodical, quick to learn and comfortable being the last line of defence before money leaves the building. What you'll do Daily funding controls (core responsibility) Run the daily pre-release checks on partner funding: gather payment evidence from our third-party partners, reconcile it to our disbursal records, and confirm that yesterday's funds reached the intended recipients before today's payments are approved. Hold, query or escalate anything that is missing, late or doesn't reconcile, and document the reason clearly so commercial, operations and risk colleagues can act on it. Keep a full audit trail of every check, exception and release decision so the control is evidenced for internal review and audit. Spot the trends in partner behaviour and payment timing that warrant a closer look, and raise them early. Run periodic verification of partner and payee bank details, and re-verify whenever a partner asks us to change where we pay them. Work with the Payments Manager to onboard more partners onto the control, and to turn the manual check into matching rules, scripts and monitoring that surface only the exceptions. Payments and finance operations Support day-to-day payment operations: cash allocation of incoming repayments, refunds and returned payments, and reconciliation against our bank and payment providers. Prepare and check payment files for approval, for example, bulk payment files for customer refunds and complaint redress. Pick up Finance Help Desk tickets from other teams: payment traces, refund and redress requests, "has this payment arrived" queries. Partner indemnity recovery Support the colleague who leads our partner indemnity recovery process. Where an agreement is cancelled, unwound or found to have been mis-sold, our partner agreements entitle us to recover amounts from the partner. You'll help validate each case against our records: confirming the agreement status, the amounts paid out and received, and what is contractually recoverable. Prepare and reconcile the recovery figures that go to partners, track invoices raised against amounts received, and chase and resolve queries and shortfalls. Support the unwind process on cancelled agreements: making sure customer refunds, partner recoveries and internal ledger entries all tie back to the same numbers. Help bring the recovery backlog under control and keep an accurate, up-to-date view of what is outstanding by partner. Strong numeracy and comfort working with large volumes of transactional data. Strong attention to detail and healthy scepticism. You can quickly identify when supporting documentation, such as a bank statement, does not fully evidence what it is intended to. Confident with Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, filters and tidy, checkable working. Clear written communication. You can explain to a non-finance colleague why a payment has been held. Confident dealing with external partners: obtaining documentation promptly and professionally, and politely pushing back where it is incomplete. Comfortable handling sensitive customer, partner and payment data responsibly. Nice to have Some exposure to Python, SQL or a similar language from your degree, a project or self-study, and an appetite to use it to automate repetitive work. We use Snowflake. An internship, placement or project involving finance, operations or messy real-world data. An interest in payments, lending or how money moves between businesses. The partner indemnity recovery backlog has been validated, invoiced where due and is tracked in one accurate, up-to-date view. title: Product Manager - UPL

As a Product Manager in UPL Growth, you will own a meaningful part of how we originate loans: the decisioning, data and product journeys that determine who we can lend to, how confidently we can make an offer, and how simply customers can access one. This is far more than keeping a mature product moving. You will have the space to identify the biggest opportunities to improve conversion, eligibility and growth, then take them from a commercial hypothesis through discovery and delivery into measurable results. That might mean rethinking how we use third-party data, improving a partner journey, or changing the rules and logic behind our lending decisions. You will work in a small, ambitious product team alongside three flexible backend engineering teams, with close partnership from Credit Risk, Data Science and First Line Risk. The work is complex, fast-moving and consequential: the decisions you shape will directly influence customer outcomes and the scale of Zopa’s lending business. The work sits closer to commercial and analytical reasoning than to customer discovery — you will spend as much time interrogating data, sizing opportunities and shaping decisioning logic as you will running user research. If that sounds like the kind of PM work you are drawn to, this role is built for you. A day in the life Own a defined area of the UPL growth roadmap, from opportunity sizing through to launch, measurement and iteration. Turn commercial and customer signals into a clear product strategy, choosing where to focus and what not to pursue. Shape the origination and decisioning experience, including the rules, journeys and data that sit behind a customer receiving a loan offer. Lead cross-functional discovery with Engineering, Credit Risk and Data Science to find the most valuable, feasible route to growth. Develop propositions that give customers greater clarity and confidence before they invest time in a full application. Make the call on scope and sequencing, balancing customer value, risk, commercial return and engineering effort. Use data to uncover friction, validate hypotheses and quantify the impact of your work. Bring new growth ideas into the roadmap, from smarter use of existing data to new external data sources and partner opportunities. Translate complex lending and technical problems into decisions that senior stakeholders can align behind. Build, launch and continually improve products that help Zopa move closer to becoming the UK’s leading unsecured lender. zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Key Account Manager EMEA (m/f/d)
description: At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees. We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team. Are you ready to join us? What you will own: Strategic Account Development Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts with ACV in the £50k–£300k+ range — and the mandate to grow them. Build and maintain a live account plan for every account in your portfolio: org map, stakeholder matrix, expansion roadmap, commercial milestones, and renewal forecast. Move relationships up the decision-maker hierarchy — from research and insights teams to VP, Director, and C-suite economic buyers. Develop the institutional depth that makes Statista’s position in each account structurally difficult to challenge: multiple threads, multiple use cases, multiple stakeholders. Drive the Enterprise Commercial Motion Run structured, consultative discovery conversations that surface the business problems Statista solves — not product pitches that describe features. Build and present business cases and ROI frameworks at executive level that justify six-figure commercial commitments. Navigate complex multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles — champion, technical buyer, economic buyer, procurement, legal — with discipline and patience. Lead Connect expansion conversations in your accounts — identifying where Statista data is being retrieved manually and positioning Connect’s consumption-based model as the infrastructure replacement. Open Statista+ conversations where accounts are using Statista data to brief decisions — positioning the analytical layer as a natural next step. Protect GRR and Drive NRR Own renewal outcomes for every account in your portfolio. Renewals are the floor. Expansion is the ceiling. Monitor and act on usage signals, stakeholder changes, and risk indicators before they become churn conversations. Run high-quality QBRs that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and create the commercial conversations that expansion depends on. Partner with the CSM aligned to your accounts to ensure adoption, value realisation, and renewal are a joined-up motion. Represent Statista in the Market Operate as a credible commercial partner at VP and C-suite level — the person clients call when they are making strategic data and intelligence decisions, not just when they need to renew a licence. Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and the StatistaIQ roadmap — in every enterprise engagement. Contribute account intelligence to the commercial planning process — where are the opportunities, where are the risks, what is the market telling us? What we are looking for: Essential Significant B2B enterprise account management experience with a track record of protecting and growing strategic accounts at £100k+ ACV. Proven ability to move relationships from operational contacts to economic buyers — and to run commercial conversations at VP and C-suite level. Evidence of running complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise cycles with rigour and discipline — not just renewing what exists. Strong consultative and discovery skills — you can run a client conversation that uncovers problems the client hasn’t articulated yet, and build a business case that justifies the investment. Commercial instinct for expansion — you see whitespace, surface latent needs, and progress expansion conversations with the same discipline as new business. Self-directed and ownership-minded — you run your accounts with the commercial rigour of a business owner, not the activity of a relationship manager. Desirable Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms. Familiarity with consumption-based or API-led commercial models. Exposure to enterprise procurement, compliance, and risk conversations in regulated industries (financial services, consulting, healthcare, technology). Experience working across multiple European markets. Fluency in a European language (French, German, Dutch) is advantageous. Why join Statista? A portfolio of enterprise accounts with significant untapped commercial headroom — the mandate to unlock it is yours. A product story that keeps getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you genuinely differentiated propositions to build enterprise relationships around. Direct partnership with the Head of KAM EMEA and VP Sales EMEA — senior support, fast decisions, and a clear mandate. A market where AI transformation is creating urgency around trusted, source-attributed data — Statista is in the right place at the right time. Real progression. Build a world-class portfolio here and you will be one of the most commercially credible enterprise account managers in the data and intelligence space. What we offer In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from: Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year Hybrid work and flex-time International team and social events Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities Career & training opportunities Attractive locations and modern offices Mental health support with OpenUp Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above. title: Account Executive - [UK&I]
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals. Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value. Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices. Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets. Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals. Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. Strong writing and editing skills, with experience producing high-quality press materials, media pitches, and other editorial content for different audiences. Experience in media relations, including pitching stories that resonate with journalists, responding to media requests, and building relationships with journalists and editors. A good understanding of the German media landscape; an initial understanding of the EMEA region, especially the UK media market and existing relationships with UK journalists are a plus. Ability to identify compelling angles and turn complex information, products, and business topics into clear and relevant stories that resonate with media. A proactive, collaborative, and reliable working style, with the confidence to engage constructively with cross-functional stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience working within a global organization or agency Experienced in analyzing data and data-led storytelling. Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership programs. Curiosity about business, technology, AI, and data topics that shape public discussion. Familiarity with AI-enabled communications is a plus. Why Statista At Statista, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions through trusted data and insights. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London / UK | Salary dependent on experience + Stock Options + Benefits </p> <p>Flex is one of Monzo’s fastest-growing and most commercially significant products. Four years ago, we reinvented the credit card experience—building something simpler, more transparent, and genuinely useful. Today, over a million customers use Flex.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Product Director to lead Flex into its next phase of growth.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, deeply commercial role at the intersection of product and credit. You’ll define how we scale borrowing responsibly, expand into new segments, and continue building products customers genuinely love.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data, Design, and senior leadership to identify new opportunities, optimise performance across complex segments, and deliver at pace.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on… </strong></p> <p><strong>Set the strategy for Flex</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set direction for one of Monzo’s most important revenue-driving products</li> <li>Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities across customer segments</li> <li>Navigate complex trade-offs between growth, risk, and customer outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Drive commercial performance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with Credit teams to shape propositions across multiple risk segments and cohorts</li> <li>Interrogate performance deeply — from unit economics to long-term profitability curves</li> <li>Identify and drive new commercial opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Champion the customer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure Flex remains rooted in strong customer outcomes, not just revenue</li> <li>Push for simple, transparent, and delightful experiences</li> <li>Advocate for customer experience alongside commercial outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build and lead a high-performing team</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage and develop a team of Product Managers</li> <li>Deliver multiple high-impact initiatives through your direct reports</li> <li>Raise the bar on product thinking and foster a culture of high standard and high velocity</li> </ul> <p><strong>🌟 What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial Thinking </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of trade-offs, economics, and outcomes</li> <li>Comfortable operating in complex environments (e.g. multiple segments and cohorts with different commercials)</li> <li>Able to engage deeply with Credit and Data partners</li> <li>Experience in lending, credit cards, or adjacent borrowing products </li> </ul> <p><strong>Consumer Focus</strong></p> <ul> <li>You start with the customer never lose track of their needs</li> <li>You’re willing to challenge revenue-driven decisions when they conflict with good customer outcomes</li> <li>You have strong product taste and care deeply about experience quality</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & Leadership </strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with multiple workstreams</li> <li>Comfortable going deep in the detail while leading through others</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across technical, credit, and governance stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> <strong>here</strong></a></p> title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Data is at the heart of Monzo's journey and our work defines the success and direction of the business. That means, similar to the rest of Monzo, Data too should be magically simple. </p> <p>We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company and use data in everything we do; from machine learning models to detect and block fraudulent payments to analysing how customers use the app to improve our app design. We're great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use.</p> <p>We contribute to an open source environment as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/data"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do.</p> <p><strong>Data Interns</strong></p> <p>As a Data intern at Monzo, you’ll be matched with a team where you’ll spend the summer working on a real project for our customers. </p> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside Data teams to learn more about what Data we analyse and how we use it to solve challenges at Monzo on a day-to-day basis.</p> <p><strong>You’ll spend your internship:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Learning about commercial products and how decisions using data can unlock more value for our customers</li> <li>Experimenting and utilising new data techniques to solve challenging problems </li> <li>Turning raw data into customer stories through models, analysis and visualisations that shape our product and app design</li> <li>Understanding the nuances of our data and building the key foundational knowledge for our new products and features</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll get exposure to: </strong></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.python.org/">Python</a> for data wrangling, analysis and building predictive solutions. </strong></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.mysql.com/"><strong>SQL</strong></a> for data modelling and gathering raw data</li> <li>Looker for data visualisation</li> <li>Spreadsheets for data analyses</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if… </strong></p> <ul> <li>You are completing a degree in STEM or Computer Science with exposure to programming and are graduating in 2028</li> <li>You enjoy learning about new technologies and have a passion for problem-solving</li> <li>You are available full-time for a minimum of 12 weeks between June and September 2027, we will have two start dates in June for you to choose.</li> <li>You have the right to work in the UK without restrictions for the full 12-week internship and would not require visa sponsorship if offered a permanent position.</li> <li>You can work from our London office on a hybrid basis to collaborate with your team and mentor, as well as attend intern events over the summer</li> </ul> <p><em>Please note you must hold the right to work in the UK through the full duration of this internship. </em></p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£42,500 pro rata</p> <p>📍This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (2 days a week in the office)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible full-time working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team </p> <p>💻 Top-spec Macbook to use over the course of your time with us </p> <p>🧠 Knowledge-sharing sessions with your squad and wider discipline </p> <p>👯 Team and company wide socials / events </p> <p>🍝 Lunch on Monzo twice a week from a range of street food vendors </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p>Our application process involves three main stages:</p> <ol> <li>Submit your application with the short questions answered </li> <li>If you’re successful, we’ll invite you to complete an exercise to demonstrate your programming and problem-solving skills</li> <li>If all goes well, you’ll have your final interviews with members of our data team via Google Meet</li> </ol> <p>The closing date for applications is 1st November 2026, but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we will be extending offers on a rolling basis.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a> <br><br>Check out <a engineering and the types of challenges engineers at Monzo solve on a day-to-day basis.</p> <p>You’ll spend your internship:</p> <ul> <li>Writing, testing and shipping code that supports new features for our customers</li> <li>Reviewing code for your colleagues, to pick up any improvements and learn from your peers</li> <li>Working with product managers, designers and data analysts on your team</li> <li>Learning about new technologies, engineering practices and what a full-time software engineering role looks like</li> <li>Proactively seeking out feedback to improve and accelerate your learning</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll be using: </strong></p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:</p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to href="http://cassandra.apache.org/"><strong>Cassandra</strong></a> for most persistent data storage</li> <li><a href="http://kafka.apache.org/"><strong>Kafka</strong></a> for our asynchronous message queue</li> <li><a href="http://kubernetes.io/"><strong>Kubernetes</strong></a> and <a href="https://www.docker.com/"><strong>Docker</strong></a> to schedule and run our services </li> <li><a href="http://aws.amazon.com/"><strong>AWS</strong></a> for most of our production infrastructure and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/"> <strong>GCP</strong></a> for most of our data if… </strong></p> <ul> <li>You are completing a degree in Computer Science or another technical field with exposure to programming and are graduating in 2028</li> <li>You enjoy learning about new technologies and have a passion for problem-solving</li> <li>You are available full-time for a minimum of 12 weeks between June and September 2027, we will have two June start dates to choose from our London office on a hybrid basis to collaborate with your team and mentor, as well as attend intern events over the summer</li> </ul> <p><em>Please note you must hold the right to work in the UK through the full duration of this internship. </em></p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£42,500 pro rata</p> <p>📍This role will be based in our London office on a hybrid basis (2 days per week in office)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible full-time working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team </p> <p>💻 Top-spec Macbook We help people start, run and grow their businesses with simple, transparent banking and tools that reduce financial admin, so they can spend more time focusing on what matters most.</p> <p>We're launching Monzo Business in Spain, initially focusing on sole traders and simple micro-businesses. While many customers will use a self-serve journey, we know there are moments where speaking to a real person can make all the difference.</p> <p>As our founding Spanish Sales Account Executive, you'll be based in London as part of our UK Sales team, and working closely with Spain Go-To-Market, Product and Marketing teams. You'll combine hands-on sales with gathering customer insight — helping potential customers move forward while shaping the playbook for how Sales can best support our growth in Spain.</p> <p>This is more than just a traditional Sales AE role focused solely on sales conversion. You will also have the opportunity to test, learn and influence how we build a safe, effective and scalable sales motion for Spain from the ground up.</p> <p><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with prospective Spanish SMB customers through discovery calls, emails and messaging, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Be a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services. Drive activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up and onboarded.</li> <li>Understand and capture detailed customer objections and feedback. Turn customer conversations into structured and actionable learnings and insights by identifying recurring questions, unmet needs, and journey friction and more.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Go To Market, Product and Marketing teams by collecting, analysing and sharing sales feedback to help teams make rapid and data-driven adjustments</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking. Qualifying and prioritising opportunities, handling objections and following up consistently to help customers progress through their journey.</li> <li>Helping shape our Spain sales playbook, including messaging, qualification, objection handling, scripts and customer journeys. Help create and refine Spanish-language scripts, FAQs, objection handling and sales processes.</li> <li>Deliver outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email, text or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieve sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands-on sales experience, ideally as an Account Executive, Sales Development Representative or Business Development Representative, and are comfortable qualifying opportunities, handling objections and following up with customers.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with Spanish culture, customer expectations and communication styles, and the judgement to adapt your approach accordingly.</li> <li>Fluent Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication in both languages.</li> <li>Strong consultative communication skills: you listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and explain complex topics simply.</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers who may be unfamiliar with Monzo or uncertain about changing their banking setup.</li> <li>You have experience gathering, structuring and analysing commercial or customer data. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. You will lead the workstreams and build agents to transform how we produce content at scale, while supporting the adoption of AI applications more broadly across the business. Throughout, you'll unlock new AI capabilities and the systems integrations that make them work within the guardrails of a regulated, financial-services environment.</p> <p>This is a role for a first-principles and systems thinker: someone who can break a complex problem down to its fundamentals, design how the pieces fit together, and build. You'll be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, and you'll be excellent at navigating a complex, stakeholder-heavy environment to get things done.</p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Martech & AI and sits within the Martech team, part of the Growth Collective. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be involved in:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Programme management:</strong> Leading our content scaling programme including translating goals into sequenced, actionable work, driving delivery, and coordinating owners and stakeholders across a complex environment.</p> <p><strong>Building AI agents:</strong> Designing and building AI agents (using tools like Claude) to transform how we produce and scale content. This means turning repeatable, manual work into reliable, well-governed automated flows, with clear judgement on where a human stays in the loop.</p> <p><strong>Systems integration and governance:</strong> Connecting AI and agents into our martech stack and data to unlock new capabilities. This means building the integrations that make them work, and doing it safely in a regulated, financial-services environment (i.e. with data protection, compliance, and the right controls built in).</p> <p><strong>Creative AI tooling:</strong> Running discovery on creative AI tooling. This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. This means driving a rigorous selection process from requirements through vendor evaluation to a clear, well-justified recommendation.</p> <p><strong>AI adoption across the business:</strong> Championing the adoption of AI-driven solutions beyond the programme, including helping other teams understand and apply AI, and sharing what works.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of building and applying AI for teams. You can point to agents, automations, or AI-driven workflows you've built and shipped that others came to rely on, ideally for a marketing or content team with people and stakeholders in the mix.</li> <li>You have strong programme leadership. You've led cross-functional programmes or workstreams end to end, sequencing the work, managing dependencies and risk, keeping stakeholders aligned, and driving delivery to a successful outcome (including picking up work already in flight).</li> <li>You're a first-principles and systems thinker who can break down a complex, ambiguous problem, design how the parts fit together, and build a solution.</li> <li>You're a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and in complex, stakeholder-heavy environments, working with individuals at all levels to get things done.</li> <li>You have a working understanding of marketing and how content and creative are produced. You know what "good" needs to look like and how to build the right guardrails around it.</li> <li>You bring martech literacy and can run a rigorous tooling selection process. This means familiarity with the tooling, integrations, data, and vendors that make up a marketing tech stack. </li> <li>You're comfortable building and integrating AI in a regulated or high-governance environment. You design for data protection, compliance, and the right human controls from the start, not as an afterthought.</li> <li>You possess excellent communication skills, translating between the business need and the technical detail so everyone's working to the same picture.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is £294,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Global Payroll Manager</strong>, ideally a candidate who thrives on building scalable systems, automating manual processes, and creating operational excellence in a high growth technology environment. </p> <p>We are looking for a leader who combines deep payroll expertise with a systems oriented mindset. You should be passionate about process improvement, automation, and leveraging technology to increase accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and employee satisfaction. Experience supporting a remote, international workforce is highly valued, as is a genuine interest in the software and technology industry.</p> <p>This is a management position which requires confidence in setting direction, driving excellence, managing priorities, developing team members, and communicating effectively with stakeholders across the business. As we continue to grow globally, you will play a key role in scaling our payroll infrastructure and raising the standard for operational excellence. This role will report to the Global Financial Controller.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. </p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with HR, Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, and external payroll providers to support payroll operations and compliance</li> <li>Manage end-to-end payroll operations across different countries, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing</li> <li>Review, validate, and approve payrolls prior to final processing</li> <li>Establish and maintain strong payroll controls to ensure data accuracy, compliance, and operational efficiency</li> <li>Perform payroll and salary cost analyses, investigating and explaining variances</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all applicable payroll tax, statutory, reporting, and employment-related requirements across jurisdictions </li> <li>Serve as the primary point of contact for payroll-related audits, coordinating responses to internal and external audit requests</li> <li>Monitor legislative and regulatory changes that may impact payroll processes, controls, or compliance obligations</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance payroll accuracy, scalability, and the employee experience</li> <li>Continue to develop, document, and maintain payroll policies, procedures, and internal controls</li> <li>Maintain strong relationships with payroll vendors and service providers, ensuring service levels and deliverables are met</li> <li>Incorporate industry best practices, emerging technology, including AI, to improve reporting quality, efficiency, and accuracy</li> <li>Lead, mentor and coach a team of global payroll professionals</li> <li>Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while identifying and managing compliance risks.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>An undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance, or a compelling narrative about your controls</li> <li>Experience managing payroll audits and regulatory requirements</li> <li>Proficiency with payroll systems, HRIS platforms, and spreadsheet-based analysis</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills</li> <li>Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience implementing or optimizing payroll platforms and HRIS systems</li> <li>Payroll management experience in publicly traded or pre-IPO companies</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>Experience supporting rapid expansion, including new country payroll launches</li> <li>A passion for technology and a desire to work with motivated colleagues</li> <li>MBA or other relevant business degree</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Manager -London
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment. - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows. - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration. - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling. - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs. - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts. - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up. - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions. title: Group Financial Controller
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Group Financial Controller</strong>.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has a deep passion for systems accounting, a track record of preparing finance functions for public markets and an innovative mindset that leverages technology and AI to build efficient and robust accounting workflows.<br>The Accounting team ensures the integrity of our financial information and serves as the primary stewards of the business’ financial health. They design and operate a governance framework underpinned by robust policies, controls and systems to provide oversight and challenge to the business. The team is responsible for timely and accurate reporting and exercises judgment when necessary based on a commitment to conservative and accurate reporting, a deep understanding of accounting principles and insights into our business.</p> <p>We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader who has a deep sense of right and wrong, high integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility, understanding that the accuracy of their work is critical to the entire Company. </p> <p>You are a methodical, detail-oriented, and process-driven problem-solver who enjoys investigating discrepancies to find their root cause. You are resilient under pressure, particularly during month-end and year-end closes, and motivated by the goal of achieving a perfect, timely, and reliable result.</p> <p>Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and some data analytics, AI and ideally software engineering experience.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Chief Financial Officer.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensuring strong understanding of the risks associated with our processes and systems and leading the development and implementation of controls to mitigate those risks</li> <li>Leading the development and identification of areas of improvement of Canonical’s policies and procedures that will enable the business to scale efficiently</li> <li>Driving the implementation of the Canonical’s policies and procedures and the monitoring of compliance </li> <li>Supporting multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Managing reviews of weekly, month-end, year-end processes from balance sheet reconciliations to management accounts and statutory accounts preparation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information</li> <li>Ensuring accuracy and completeness of the recording and reporting of financial data and transactions to ensure that the Company maintains robust accounting records</li> <li>Upholding the Company’s accounting and approval processes and controls across the organization</li> <li>Managing external audits </li> <li>Developing a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions in which Canonical operates and lead the assurance of Canonical’s compliance with such regulatory requirements</li> <li>Driving projects associated with upgrading or implementing new finance systems and sensible AI adoption in the team</li> <li>Developing professional relationships and manage communications with both internal and external stakeholders - customers, vendors, tax authorities and external advisers -  including resolving questions and issues confidentially and  in a timely manner</li> <li>Managing or mentoring junior accounting staff, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A strong academic background and professional qualification in Accounting or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)</li> <li>Extensive practical IFRS knowledge and experience</li> <li>Advanced Excel skills and strong data analysis capabilities</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced setting</li> <li>Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with colleagues, management, customers, and external stakeholders</li> <li>A proactive, analytical mindset with a genuine passion for finance and a drive for continuous improvement, process efficiency and professional development</li> <li>Proven experience using enterprise-level accounting or ERP systems</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with NetSuite</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Experience with a Big 4 Accounting Firm, or a Public company</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.
